description: Foundation of familyHelp: ticket CRUD, family member identity, dashboard views, comment threads, assignment workflow, and PIN-protected settings. Everything needed for the family to file and resolve help requests.
principles: Force real detail in tickets -- no '3-word' requests
Parents are admins, kids are participants
Simple status workflow, not enterprise ITIL
Same tech stack and patterns as familyDinner and familyPlan
Relative paths everywhere for nginx /help/ subpath

userStories.title: Member identity and dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: First visit shows member picker, selection persists in localStorage (fh_member)
Dashboard shows two lists: tickets I filed, tickets assigned to me
Badge counts show open/actionable ticket counts

userStories.title: Assignment and status workflow
